scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w worker" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:production: npm run check && npm run deploy:production -w worker
